propositions: New hard-fail CI gates/floors/caps introduced to the rebar code-review gate lack a grandfather mechanism and break branches that predated the gate configuration
The project needs an advisory code-review criterion that detects whether a pipeline/gate-configuration change introduces a hard-fail step or required gate without if-present/grandfather guard logic

The criterion must be triggered declaratively via glob patterns matching CI system config files across multiple vendors (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure, Buildkite, Bitbucket, Drone) without hard-coding any single vendor
Project code-review criteria activated today are dispatched unconditionally regardless of whether the criterion applies to changed files, so applies_to globs have no effect on project criteria
The applies_to glob set must be overridable via a config key so projects can declare their own CI pipeline file patterns without requiring code changes
